note: Source of truth for this skill's module catalog. `step` is the position in SKILL.md's procedure, not a phase of a multi-invocation workflow — this skill runs inside one. Every deterministic module names an `engine` (an `mcp:<tool>` validated against src/mcp/server.py by check_consistency.py, an `external:<tool>`, or an `agent:<how>`), so none free-rides on a sibling's mechanism. The catalog's own shape carries the skill's one idea: the modules split by TRUST, not by topic — `image-evidence` and `palette-fact-check` are D0 over decoded pixels, `visual-inference` and `pixel-comparison` are D2 over the same image, and reading one as the other is the failure this skill exists to prevent.

modules.notes: Geometry + the real color histogram with per-color coverage. Produces no pin: it produces FACTS, which constrain and refute the inference modules. An unreadable format returns `unchecked` with the reason — a coverage gap, never a clean bill.

Component identity, color ROLE, layout system, type roles. D2 whatever the confidence sounds like, so each lands as a pin carrying provenance agent_assumption — visible on the map, vetoable in the interview, attackable by the challenger. Naming the engine is what makes this a workflow rather than a description of one.

The proposed colors against the pixels they claim to come from, plus WCAG on the claimed pairs. A claimed token covering nothing is a hallucinated color, refuted at the contract instead of after propagation. Set membership and arithmetic, so confidence extracted — it skips fp-check like a type error.

The state matrix, breakpoints, theme, real-vs-placeholder data, behavior, a11y semantics, motion, assets, i18n — everything one still frame structurally cannot show. This is the module that distinguishes the skill from a generator: the invented answers are the ones that cause rework, and here they are asked instead.

When the project already declares a design system, harvest it and check the reference against it rather than authoring a second palette. A screenshot that disagrees with the house system is a decision, not a license.

The elected values become a DTCG contract projected into tokens.css / theme.css / DESIGN.md. This is the carrier greenfield's design-propagation named for 'captured from an approved visual direction' and never had: the screenshot the user chose IS the approved direction.

Re-extract the generated CSS variables and diff them against the DTCG contract; a correct generator round-trips to zero drift. Catches an edit to the token DEFINITIONS, where design_scan catches a component USING an off-contract value.

The blocking half of the look-again loop, run against the running URL at every elected breakpoint: token membership against the generated DESIGN.md, plus the computable a11y subset. Deterministic, so it gates the merge.

modules.engine: agent:name the difference in words, then route it as defect-or-undecided for a human
modules.notes: Does it LOOK like the picture — a deterministic mechanism over a noisy signal (anti-aliasing, font hinting, GPU/OS rendering, an unknown capture density), so it is a human-reviewed pin and never a gate. Differences are stated in words, not as a diff percentage: a named difference is decidable, a score is not.
